description: This file defines the internal class AdoNetStreamQueueMapper, which maps Orleans stream and queue identifiers to ADO.NET queue identifiers, utilizing caching for efficient lookups.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Internal class that maps Orleans stream and queue identifiers to ADO.NET queue identifiers with caching.

methods.name: GetAdoNetQueueId
methods.description: Returns the ADO.NET QueueId for a given Orleans StreamId or QueueId.

methods.name: GetAllAdoNetQueueIds
methods.description: Retrieves all ADO.NET QueueIds in the current space.
